scripts.build: npm run build -w @tracegenie/shared && npm run build -w @vertaware/email && npm run build -w @tracegenie/api && npm run build -w @tracegenie/widget && npm run build -w @tracegenie/admin && npm run build -w @tracegenie/demo
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tracegenie/shared && npm run test:core && npm run test:email-ui && npm run test:widget && npm run test:motion-ui && npm run test:widget-flow && npm run test:setup
scripts.test:widget: npm exec -w @tracegenie/widget -- vitest run test/ImagePrivacy.test.tsx test/ScreenshotPrivacyEditor.test.tsx test/CaptureAttachments.test.tsx test/SessionToken.test.tsx test/EmbedOrigin.test.tsx
scripts.test:motion-ui: npm exec -w @tracegenie/admin -- vitest run test/Motion.test.tsx test/ConfirmDialog.test.tsx test/Menu.test.tsx test/DataTable.test.tsx test/Toast.test.tsx
scripts.test:widget-flow: npm exec -w @tracegenie/widget -- vitest run test/FeedbackWidget.test.tsx --testNamePattern='^(?!.*(?:active product survey|whitespace-only survey|survey-only reports|restored survey data|matching survey state|configured prompt changes|edits made during a delayed submission)).*$'
scripts.test:setup: node --test scripts/local-env.test.mjs && node --import tsx --test apps/api/src/modules/installation/installation.test.ts && npm exec -w @tracegenie/admin -- vitest run test/InstallationEntry.test.tsx
